work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCXXXI to Archbishop-bishop Francesco Saverio Caruana of Malta against the secret societies spreading in his diocese, citing Clement XII, Benedict XIV, Pius VII, Leo XII and Mirari vos; address, intitulation, greeting, body, blessing and dating clause survive. Its provenance is note2 LF40830; its two Leo-the-Great source notes (LF40961, LF41100) are retained. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF40809–40809; the source dating clause at LF40997–41004 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem die trigesima prima augusti anno mille- simo octingentesimo quadragesimo tertio, pon- tificatus Nostri anno decimo tertio. Isolated OCR marks fused into body lines remain literal and are not removed or corrected: LF40967 “|”. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
